responsibility: Implements storage and update logic for gm2’s global compiler options. It parses and remembers path names, output/dependency file arguments, preprocessor arguments, runtime-module overrides, warning and checking switches, dialect and optimization flags, save-temps and dump directories, scaffold and shared-library settings, and location overrides, while also constructing the effective cpp command line and deriving final inferred settings after option parsing.
same_name_distinction: Implementation module for the M2Options pair: it owns the backing storage and procedures that parse, remember, and finalize compiler-option values such as paths, cpp arguments, save-temps, runtime overrides, and warning/check flags, whereas `gcc/m2/gm2-compiler/M2Options.def` only exports that state and API.
